oneTimers: $57M of restructuring and other charges under Intel's 2024 Restructuring Plan — a small quarter after $6,970M for the full year, most of it booked in Q3; excluded from non-GAAP results. A year ago the same line was a $(1,142)M credit, mostly a benefit from VLSI litigation developments, which is why total operating expenses rose even as R&D and MG&A fell.
A $316M gain on equity investments, net, versus an $86M gain a year ago — mark-to-market moves on Intel's investment portfolio rather than chip sales; excluded from non-GAAP results.
$560M of interest received on the refunded European Commission fine (paid in 2009, annulled, refunded in 2022) — a one-off receipt inside interest and other, net; excluded from non-GAAP results.
A $39M loss from divestiture — deferred consideration on the NAND sale to SK hynix; excluded from non-GAAP results.

For the full year, a $9,925M non-cash valuation allowance against US deferred tax assets — recorded because Intel's GAAP results showed a cumulative loss — drove the full-year GAAP tax rate to 71.6% and the $18,756M net loss attributable to Intel. None of the allowance was recorded in Q4 itself; Intel excludes it from non-GAAP results.
otherDetail: Other income of $187M combines a $316M gain on equity investments, net with $(129)M of interest and other, net — the interest line includes $560M received on the annulled European Commission fine. Intel recorded a $752M tax provision on $599M of pre-tax income, a 125.5% GAAP tax rate: the tax bill was larger than the profit it was levied on.
pngFooterNote: Operating profit of $412M became a $153M loss after tax.

segments.name: Client Computing Group
segments.note: PC and client chips; down 9% YoY. Segment operating income was $3,056M, down from $3,567M a year ago.

segments.name: Data Center and AI
segments.note: Xeon server chips and AI data-center products; down 3% YoY. Segment operating income was $233M, down from $738M a year ago.

segments.name: Network and Edge
segments.note: Networking and edge-computing chips; up 10% YoY. Segment operating income was $340M, up from $109M a year ago. Intel folded NEX into CCG and DCAI starting in Q1 2025, so this is its last quarter as a standalone segment.

segments.name: Intel Foundry
segments.note: Intel's chip factories, shown at their $214M of sales to OUTSIDE customers only (derived: $385M for full-year 2024 per the 10-K, less $171M in the first nine months per the Q3 2024 10-Q). Foundry's total segment revenue was $4,502M, but $4,288M of that was wafers sold to Intel's own product groups — counting it here would count the same dollars twice. Foundry lost $2,260M in the quarter.

segments.name: All other
segments.note: Mobileye (self-driving tech), Altera and smaller businesses. Intel reports this group at $1,042M; it is shown as $1,019M here, net of $23M of intersegment eliminations not attributable to Foundry, so the parts sum exactly to Intel's $14,260M total. Down 20% YoY. Segment operating income was $118M.

sources.label: Form 10-K for the year ended Dec 28, 2024 (SEC EDGAR)

takeaways.text: Revenue fell 7% to $14.3B and gross margin slid to 39.2% from 45.7% a year ago, but Intel still earned $412M from operations after cutting R&D and MG&A 9% to $5.1B. A $752M tax bill on $599M of pre-tax income — a 125.5% rate — pushed the bottom line to a $153M net loss. GAAP EPS was $(0.03); non-GAAP EPS was $0.13.
takeaways.title: Profitable operations, unprofitable quarter

takeaways.text: Intel Foundry lost $2,260M on $4,502M of segment revenue, and only $214M of that revenue came from outside customers — the rest was wafers sold to Intel's own product groups. Client Computing still earned $3,056M, Data Center and AI earned $233M and Network and Edge earned $340M.
takeaways.title: Foundry lost far more than the whole company

takeaways.text: Operating cash flow was $3,165M, but after $4,667M of net spending on property, plant and equipment, adjusted free cash flow was $(1,503)M. Q1 2025 guidance is $11.7–12.7B of revenue with GAAP EPS of $(0.27). Intel signed its CHIPS Act award for up to $7.86B and received $1.1B in the quarter; headcount fell to 108.9K from 124.8K a year ago.
takeaways.title: Cash burned while the new plan takes shape

verdict: Intel's chip business earned $412 million from operations in the fourth quarter, but a $752 million tax bill — bigger than its $599 million of pre-tax income — turned that profit into a $153 million net loss.
